description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A unique token used to ensure idempotence. This parameter value is generated by the client and must be unique across different requests. The value can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length.
Specifies whether to immediately deploy the pipeline.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch update-pipelines --instance-id ls-cn-oew1qbgl0000 --trigger false --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF0000 --biz-body example-string --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
